paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.

The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy scores across several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 43 to 56, with tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue, solid line with circular markers represents "Squared-Exponential-Tanh", starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.8 at 0 demonstrations and ending at approximately 53.4 at 1500 demonstrations, showing a slight decline over the range.  A purple, solid line with circular markers represents "ELU", beginning at approximately 46.5 at 0 demonstrations and ending at approximately 46.2 at 1500 demonstrations, with a gradual decline. A light purple solid line with circular markers represents "Tanh", starting at an accuracy of roughly 47.8 at 0 demonstrations and terminating at approximately 47.5 at 1500 demonstrations, trending downward. A dashed, red line with circular markers represents "LLaMA-2-chat-7B", beginning at approximately 48.7 at 0 demonstrations and declining to approximately 48.4 at 1500 demonstrations. A horizontal, dashed line is also present at an accuracy of 43.
